title: Composer lockfile without a content hash
description: composer.lock declares a `composer.lock` that records no usable `content-hash`. Composer cannot tell whether the lockfile matches `composer.json`, so an install can proceed from a stale lock the review never covered.
remediation: Regenerate the lockfile with `composer update --lock` and commit it.
limitation: It matches a `composer.lock` that records no usable `content-hash` in the parsed composer.lock; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
